tables.name: edges
tables.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (CAST(geom AS GEOMETRY) AS geom) FROM read_csv('sampledata/edges.csv')

tables.name: vertices
tables.sql: SELECT id, CAST(in_edges AS BIGINT[]) AS in_edges, CAST(out_edges AS BIGINT[]) AS out_edges, x, y FROM read_csv('sampledata/vertices.csv')

tables.name: pointsofinterest
tables.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (CAST(geom AS GEOMETRY) AS geom) FROM read_csv('sampledata/pointsofinterest.csv')

tables.name: restrictions
tables.sql: SELECT id, CAST(path AS BIGINT[]) AS path, CAST(cost AS DOUBLE) AS cost FROM read_csv('sampledata/restrictions.csv')

map.vertices: SELECT id, x, y FROM vertices
map.edges: SELECT id, source, target FROM edges
map.points: SELECT pid, edge_id, fraction FROM pointsofinterest
